office_does: The auditor runs Mason County's elections and voter registration, records deeds and documents, issues licenses and keeps the county's accounts and financial reports.
race_blurb: First-term Auditor Steve Duenkel, a Republican who also chairs the county Republican Party, runs on financial oversight and election security. Democrat Tamra Ingwaldson, a former United Way director who led the primary, promises nonpartisan administration and better support for staff.

candidates.summary: Former United Way of Mason County executive director and telecom employee, now with a tiny-home village nonprofit, running to make the auditor's office nonpartisan and more open.
highlights: Over 20 years in nonprofit management and 20 in corporate telecommunications; no prior elected office [S1][S4]
Says an auditor who chairs a political party has a conflict of interest; promises administration 'without political influence' [S5]
Promises secure, accessible elections and better tools, training and staffing for office staff [S1][S5]
Endorsed by former auditors Karen Herr and Paddy McGuire, Commissioner Sharon Trask and the Mason County Democrats [S6]

experience.basis: First-time candidate from nonprofit and corporate work, running to change how the office is led, though with long organizational leadership.

candidates.summary: Mason County Auditor since 2023 and county Republican Party chair, with a 37-year finance career at Boeing, Safeco and a small business, running as the county's financial 'watch dog'.
highlights: Promises internal audits and controls 'to ensure your tax dollars are properly spent' and stronger budget oversight [S1][S3]
Told commissioners in 2026 the county was below its reserve policy; a commissioner disputed it [S7]
Plans tabulation-equipment upgrades and continued voter-roll maintenance [S1][S3]
Filed, then withdrew, deepfake lawsuits against a commissioner and an opponent's campaign treasurer [S5][S6]
Endorsed by former Democratic Auditor Al Brotche and former Secretary of State Sam Reed [S1][S3]

spending.basis: Repeated, explicit focus on fiscal oversight: internal audits and controls on county spending, budget oversight, and public warnings that the county is short of its reserve policy.

experience.basis: First-term incumbent running on his record in the office.
